description: OBJECTIVE The Department of Veterans Affairs has a requirement to install valves on water supply lines to enable individual building isolation from the campus water supply at the Rocky Mountain Regional VA Medical Center. Facility Management Services has identified approximately 30 valves on domestic cold water, domestic hot water, and domestic hot water return that require valve installation or valve replacement. The intent of this contract is to install isolation shutoff valves on the domestic cold water (DCW), domestic hot water (DHW), and domestic hot water recirculation (DHWR) pipes at key points to allow facilities maintenance to control water flow to individual buildings. description: Purpose Pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10, the DoWEA Procurement Office is currently conducting market research to identify companies capable of and qualified to provide Daily Commute (DC) student bus transportation services in support of the Baumholder Military Community in Germany. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for conducting market research and does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP), Invitation for Bids (IFB), or Request for Quotations (RFQ), and does not obligate the Government to any current or future commitments. Scope of Work (Draft) DoWEA is seeking full student transportation services to the Baumholder Military Community in Germany. The prospective contractor shall provide all personnel, including drivers, safety attendants, supervision, services, supplies, and equipment necessary to perform student transportation services. Contracted services shall comply with DoWEA and Host Nation requirements for student transportation. Please see the attached draft PWS for additional information. Please note that the draft PWS is subject to change prior to issuance of the solicitation. The period of performance for these services will begin on 01 August 2027. For purposes of this acquisition, the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 485410, School and Employee Bus Transportation, Size Standard, $30.0M. The Product Service Code (PSC) is V222, Transportation/Travel/Relocation/Travel/Lodging/Recruitment: Passenger Motor Charter. Requested Information If your company is interested, capable, and qualified to provide these services, please submit the following information: Statement of Interest Please indicate your interest in participating in this potential requirement. Capability Statement (Maximum of 3 pages) Please provide a brief description of your company�s qualifications, relevant experience, and technical capabilities to meet the draft scope of work. Vendors� email message shall state �HE125427REBAUMHOLDER� in the subject line. Telephone calls regarding this RFI will not be accepted. In accordance with FAR 15.101(c)(3), the Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of the RFI or otherwise pay for the information requested, and responses will be treated as information only and not as a proposal. title: Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO)
description: The Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) is interested in awarding funding agreements (Agreements) to nontraditional and traditional defense contractors to carry out prototype projects that are directly relevant to enhancing the mission effectiveness of military personnel and the supporting platforms, systems, components, or materials proposed to be acquired or developed by the Department of Defense (DoD), or to improvement of platforms, systems, components, or materials in use by the Armed Forces of the United States. As such, DIU hereby announces the release of their streamlined Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO). This CSO is seeking proposals for innovative, commercial technologies that accelerate attainment of asymmetric defense capabilities. In this context, innovative means any new technology, process, or business practice, or any new application of an existing technology, process, or business practice that contributes to the sustainment of global peace and U.S. national security. Agreements will be sought under an open (available for five (5) years), competitive (solution brief/demonstration followed by proposal) CSO. This CSO is considered a competitive process, intended to ensure that competitive procedures are used to the maximum extent practicable when entering into Agreements to carry out these prototype projects. Interested parties with current or new/developmental innovative technological solutions or enhancements are highly encouraged to visit the DIU website to obtain more information regarding the process of presenting their solutions to DIU and the potential for securing said Agreements under this CSO. Topic Areas of Interest (AoI) will be posted on the DIU website and may be updated at any time. Please note that the submission period for solution briefs under the identified AOI's will be open for a limited period of time, so check the DIU website for updates frequently. DIU's website is: https://www.diu.mil/work-with-us

title: FY27-28 Pediatric Flu Vaccines
description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) awards contracts to the manufacturers of pediatric vaccines for the purchase of standard commercial pediatric vaccines. Vaccines are one of the most cost-effective ways to prevent disease and reduce healthcare costs. The Vaccine for Children (VFC) program, established pursuant to Section 13631 of the Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1993 (OBRA �93), guarantees federal support for the purchase and supply of sufficient quantities of vaccine to the States to cover a defined group of children. The program helps assure the implementation of effective immunization practices and proper use of vaccines to achieve higher immunization coverage. Children (18 years-of-age or younger) who qualify for immunization through the VFC purchase program include those who are (1) Medicaid-eligible, (2) without health insurance, (3) American Indian/Alaska native (as defined in Subsection (h)(3) of the OBRA �93), or (4) children with health insurance, which does not cover the cost of vaccines, if they receive their immunizations at a Federally-qualified health center or rural health clinic (as defined by the Social Security Act). Health care providers who agree to certain requirements are eligible through the States to receive free vaccine through this VFC purchase program. The establishment of these contracts provides an opportunity to utilize VFC funds and Section 317 vaccine purchase funds to obtain vaccines at prices below those available in the commercial marketplace. In addition, awardees may opt to purchase additional quantities of vaccine under any resulting contract to provide immunizations for children who are not federally vaccine-eligible children using state and local funds. title: AdvM Call for Solutions - Modernized Paint Line in SOD
description: The Army Contracting Command � Redstone Arsenal (ACC-RSA), on behalf of Tobyhanna Army Depot (TYAD), is seeking innovative solutions to automate and modernize its existing paint conveyor line. The Government requires a comprehensive, fully functioning solution consisting of a suite of hardware, automated parts handling equipment, and open-architecture Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) software to perform all aspects of automated paint application, curing, and automated shop operations. title: USFS R6 Slide in Water Tank
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. Quotations are being requested. The U.S. Forest Service (Gifford Pinchot National Forest, Wind River Ranger District) requires the acquisition of a brand-new, commercial-grade, slide-in water tank unit. This system will be deployed in an existing government-owned dump truck host vehicle and operated primarily on rough, unpaved, and mountainous U.S. Forest Service access roads. EXCLUSIONS: This acquisition explicitly DOES NOT include the purchase or provision of a new dump truck vehicle body. INCLUSIONS: This requirement is strictly for the fabrication, testing, and turn-key delivery of the complete slide-in water tank unit and matching securement hardware kit as detailed below 2. Schedule of Items (CLIN Structure) This procurement is conducted under FAR Part 12 Simplified Acquisition Procedures [12.203]. Bidders must submit a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) quote covering all items to be considered responsive: CLIN 0001: Slide-in Water Tank Unit (2,600 - 3,000 Gallon Capacity, as specified) | Qty: 1 | Unit: EA CLIN 0002: Shipping and Handling: FOB Destination to Carson, WA 98610. (Note: Shipping costs will be evaluated but only executed if the successful contractor's facility is located outside the 100-mile local government pickup radius). 3. Core Technical Salient Characteristics Summary The manufactured water tank system must conform strictly to the mechanical and physical boundaries of the government's host vehicle (2013 Freightliner M2, 4-Axle Dump Truck equipped with a drop axle). Physical Footprint Box Constraints: Main Tank Truck Box Clearance: Main tank structure must drop cleanly into the truck bed box dimensions (180�L � 72�W � 54�H). Ultimate System Maximum Footprint: Total overall footprint of the completed assembly�inclusive of the tank box shell, rear plumbing manifolds, auxiliary pumps, engines, utility reels, and guards�must not exceed 216� Long � 72� Wide � 66� High. Rear Overhang Allowance: Bidders are permitted to utilize up to a 216-inch overall footprint length, allowing the rear subframe, auxiliary pump assembly, plumbing manifold, and brush guard to overhang past the 180-inch rear edge of the dump bed floor. Capacity & Fluid Control: Minimum 2,600-gallon operational fluid capacity required, with a target performance goal of 3,000 gallons. Built with engineered internal lateral and longitudinal baffles to control intense liquid surge on off-road terrain. Structural Integration & Support Legs: Heavy-duty tie-down loops or D-rings welded onto the front and rear faces of a 5-inch steel tube perimeter subframe. Must feature an integrated, self-contained structural storage stand or folding drop-leg support jacks capable of supporting the fully evacuated weight of the unit to allow for independent loading and unloading without requiring external heavy machinery (cranes or forklifts). Standalone Pump & Engine Setup: High-performance, single-stage centrifugal transfer/fire pump matching or exceeding 110 GPM at 100 PSI (High-Pressure) and 430 GPM at 25 PSI (High-Volume). Equipped with an integrated priming system capable of self-loading/draft from a static environmental water source. Completely self-powered via a dedicated auxiliary engine (minimum 23 HP, V-Twin gas or diesel equivalent) with an independent 5-gallon fuel tank. Vehicle PTO, hydrostatic, or hydraulic-driven pump systems are strictly prohibited. Auxiliary Equipment Protection: If any part of the motor, pump assembly, or hose reel hangs past the truck bed floor, an integrated steel tubular wrap-around brush guard/cage is mandatory to shield mechanical parts from backing impacts and flying debris. title: Kosteikkojen suunnittelu ja työmaavalvonta sekä vesienhallintasuunnitelman työmaavalvonta, 2026-2027 LIFE Revives -hankkeessa
description: Sisä-Suomen elinvoimakeskuksen LIFE Revives -hankkeessa hankitaan: 1) kosteikkojen suunnittelua (2 kpl) ja myöhemmässä vaiheessa niiden työmaavalvonta, vuosina 2026-2027 2) Pinsiönniityn vesienhallintasuunnitelman työmaavalvonta, vuosina 2026-2027 Toimeksiannon kohteet sijaitsevat Pirkanmaan raakkujokien (Ruonanjoki ja Pinsiön-Matalusjoki) valuma-alueille. Hankinnan toteuttaminen edellyttää rahoituksen varmistumista., Kosteikkojen (2 kpl) suunnittelu ja työmaavalvonta, 2026-2027 LIFE Revives -hankkeessa Toimeksiannon kohde on laatia Pirkanmaan raakkujokien (Ruonanjoki ja Pinsiön-Matalusjoki) valuma-alueille yksityiskohtaiset vesiensuojelulliset kosteikkosuunnitelmat, joiden pohjalta pystytään suoraan tilaamaan niiden toteutus. Kosteikkojen suunnittelun ja myöhemmin perustamisen tavoitteena on vähentää valuma-alueilta jokiin saapuvaa kuormaa: valumavedet suodattuvat kulkiessaan kosteikkojen läpi pidättäen ravinteita ja kiintoaineita. Tämän lisäksi kosteikoilla on merkittävä rooli niin biodiversiteetin ylläpitäjinä kuin virkistysalueina. Kosteikkoja suunnitellaan yhteensä 2 kpl; Ruonanjoelle valuma-alueelle 1 kpl ja Pinsiön-Matalusjoelle valuma-alueelle 1 kpl, kiinnostuneiden maanomistajien kiinteistöille. Kosteikkosuunnitelmat noudattavat sisällöltään soveltuvin osin liitteenä olevaa kosteikkosuunnitelman sisältömallia (liite 2) ja täyttävät mahdollisesti myös ei-tuotannollisen investointiin liitettävien suunnitelmien ehdot. Tilaaja vastaa maanomistajilta saatavista suostumuksista. Tarvittavat maastomittaukset ja -tutkimukset sisältyvät konsultin tehtäviin, kuten myös kosteikon valuma-alueen tarkempi määritys ja kosteikon tarkempi sijainti. Konsultin ratkaistavaksi jää suunnitellaanko kosteikot toteutettavaksi padottamalla, kaivamalla vai näiden yhdistelmällä. Kosteikot tulee suunnitella kuitenkin siten, että niillä ei ole vesilain mukaisen luvan tarvetta ja eikä niiden toteutuksista aiheudu kiintoainekuormitusta raakkujokiin. Kosteikkojen rakentaminen on tarkoitus toteuttaa talvityönä. Toimenpiteiden suunnittelussa tulee huomioida, että toimitaan vesistövaikutuksille erittäin herkän eliölajin valuma-alueella. Suunnittelua tulee tehdä yhteistyössä maanomistajien kanssa, esimerkiksi tarkempi sijainti ja pinta-ala sovitaan maanomistajien kanssa yhteistyössä. Suunnittelijan vastuulla on tiedottaa maanomistajia suunnittelusta. Suunnitellun lisäksi urakoitsija vastaa kosteikkojen urakan valvontatyöstä, sisältäen: • kaivinkoneurakoitsijan kilpailutuksessa avustaminen (6 h) • mahdollisen puunkorjuun suorittamisen työnvalvonta • Ennakoitavat merkintätyöt (riippuen onko urakoitsijalla 3D-koneenohjausjärjestelmä) • patorakentamisen valvonta • säätökaivon ja kosteikon vedenjohtamisrakenteiden toteutuksen valvonta • kosteikkoalueen saarekkeet, nimekkeet sekä kaivu- ja muotoilutöiden valvonta • työvalvontakäynneistä raporttien laadinta tilaajalle / maanomistajalle • työmaan ajallinen valvonta, työn aikataulussa pysyminen • työnaikaisen suunnittelun seuranta ja suunnitelmien tarkistaminen • työmaan työturvallisuuden valvonta ja työturvallisuusasiakirjan laadinta (turvallisuuskoordinaattori) • aloituskokouksen ja työn vastaanottokatselmuksen valmistelu (urakoitsija, maanomistaja ja elinvoimakeskus) • loppuraportointi työn teknisestä toteutuksesta, Pinsiönniityn vesienhallintasuunnitelman työmaavalvonta, 2026-2027 LIFE Revives -hankkeessa Pinsiönniityn vesienhallintasuunnitelman on laatinut KVVY Tutkimus Oy vuonna 2026 (liite 3). Suunnitelman tavoitteena on parantaa Pinsiönjoen pääuoman vedenjohtavuutta, parantaa uoman vakautta sekä samalla vähentää peltojen aiheuttamaa ravinnekuormitusta. Vedenjohtavuutta parannetaan lisäämällä hallitusti uoman tilavuutta kaksitasouomarakenteella. Lisäksi kaksitasouoman yläpuolelle rakennetaan tulvapenger varmistamaan, ettei tulvavedet pääse nousemaan pelloille. Tulvahylly kasvillistuessaan hidastaa veden virtausta ja näin ollen mahdollistaa kiintoaineksen ja siinä olevien ravinteiden laskeutumista tulvahyllylle. Toimenpiteiden yhteensovittamisen myötä parannetaan alueella olevien luontoarvojen säilymistä sekä parannetaan maanomistajien kestävämpää maankäyttöä. title: Class 4 Inshore Patrol Vessels
description: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), Air and Marine Operations (AMO), is conducting market research to identify industry capabilities for commercially available or custom-configured Class 4 Inshore Patrol Vessels (IPVs) for use by the U.S. Border Patrol (USBP). The vessels will support inshore patrol, law enforcement, interdiction, search and rescue, deterrence, reconnaissance, and maritime awareness missions in rivers, lakes, bays, coastal areas, the Great Lakes, and other inshore operating environments. CBP is considering two vessel categories: Patrol Boat-Small (PC1): A nimble vessel, 25 feet or less, intended for shallow and obstructed waterways such as riverine environments. Patrol Boat-Medium (PC2): A stable vessel, at least 25 feet and no more than 29 feet, intended for rougher open waters, including the Great Lakes and coastal/inshore areas. CBP requests vendor feedback on the draft RFI and draft performance specification, including the availability of commercial-off-the-shelf or modified/custom vessel solutions, ability to meet requirements, requirements that may present challenges, recommended changes or clarifications, perceived technical or production risks, warranty terms, estimated pricing, production capacity, delivery schedules, and relevant experience producing similar vessels for the U.S. Government or comparable customers. This notice is for market research purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation or request for proposals. The Government does not intend to award a contract based solely on this notice and will not reimburse respondents for costs associated with preparing or submitting information. Attachments provide additional draft requirements and requested response information.

title: MEARNG F550 Emergency Light Installation
description: The Maine Army National Guard (MEARNG) requires the professional installation of a complete, government-furnished, emergency response vehicle police-style flashing light system and a battery charging system onto a Government-owned Ford F-550 Vehicle Mounted Radiation Detection System (VMRDS). The contractor shall provide all necessary personnel, tools, materials (excluding specified government-furnished equipment), and expertise to complete the installation. Scope of Work: The contractor is required to perform the following installations and integrations on the Ford F-550 vehicle: Equipment Installation: Install all Government-Furnished Equipment (GFE) at specified locations. This includes a Whelen Inner Edge light assembly, a Whelen Core and Controller unit, and various Whelen body, slim, and trio lights. System Integration: Professionally integrate all lighting components with the central controller. All wiring must be routed, secured, protected with grommets where necessary, and concealed appropriately. Power System Installation: Install one Kussmaul battery tender complete with an auto-eject shore power connection to charge the vehicle's batteries. Functional Testing: Conduct a full functional test of the integrated lighting system and the power system in the presence of a Government representative to demonstrate proper functionality. Vehicle Restoration: Upon completion, repair any damage to the vehicle resulting from installation activities and ensure all work areas are cleaned of debris, materials, and tools. Government Furnished Equipment (GFE): The Government will provide the following major components for installation: One (1) Whelen Inner Edge light assembly One (1) Whelen Core and Controller unit Two (2) Whelen slim lights (for front grill) Eight (8) Whelen body lights Two (2) Whelen trio lights Two (2) Whelen slim lights (for front fenders) One (1) Kussmaul battery tender Contractor Requirements: Provide all personnel, equipment, tools, materials (except GFE), and supervision. Ensure all employees possess the required skillsets or licensing to install the lighting system according to manufacturer specifications. The place of performance will be the contractor's installation facility. The period of performance for the installation shall not exceed one week. Period of Performance: The work must be completed within one (1) week from the start date. Questions: May be submitted to the points of contact below. The due date for questions is 09SEP2026. Submission Instructions: All quotes must be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist, Thomas J. Ryan, at thomas.j.ryan36.civ@army.mil and the Contracting Officer, Darlene Howes, at darlene.r.howes.civ@army.mil. Quotes must include a completed SF 1449 and a separate Technical Proposal responding to the evaluation criteria outlined in the FAR 52.212-1 and 52.212-2 Addenda.

title: MEARNG F550 Emergency Light Installation
description: The Maine Army National Guard (MEARNG) requires the professional installation of a complete, government-furnished, emergency response vehicle police-style flashing light system and a battery charging system onto a Government-owned Ford F-550 Vehicle Mounted Radiation Detection System (VMRDS). The contractor shall provide all necessary personnel, tools, materials (excluding specified government-furnished equipment), and expertise to complete the installation. Scope of Work: The contractor is required to perform the following installations and integrations on the Ford F-550 vehicle: Equipment Installation: Install all Government-Furnished Equipment (GFE) at specified locations. This includes a Whelen Inner Edge light assembly, a Whelen Core and Controller unit, and various Whelen body, slim, and trio lights. System Integration: Professionally integrate all lighting components with the central controller. All wiring must be routed, secured, protected with grommets where necessary, and concealed appropriately. Power System Installation: Install one Kussmaul battery tender complete with an auto-eject shore power connection to charge the vehicle's batteries. Functional Testing: Conduct a full functional test of the integrated lighting system and the power system in the presence of a Government representative to demonstrate proper functionality. Vehicle Restoration: Upon completion, repair any damage to the vehicle resulting from installation activities and ensure all work areas are cleaned of debris, materials, and tools. Government Furnished Equipment (GFE): The Government will provide the following major components for installation: One (1) Whelen Inner Edge light assembly One (1) Whelen Core and Controller unit Two (2) Whelen slim lights (for front grill) Eight (8) Whelen body lights Two (2) Whelen trio lights Two (2) Whelen slim lights (for front fenders) One (1) Kussmaul battery tender Contractor Requirements: Provide all personnel, equipment, tools, materials (except GFE), and supervision. Ensure all employees possess the required skillsets or licensing to install the lighting system according to manufacturer specifications. The place of performance will be the contractor's installation facility. The period of performance for the installation shall not exceed one week. Period of Performance: The work must be completed within one (1) week from the start date. Questions: May be submitted to the points of contact below. The due date for questions is 09SEP2026. Submission Instructions: All quotes must be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist, Thomas J. Ryan, at thomas.j.ryan36.civ@army.mil and the Contracting Officer, Darlene Howes, at darlene.r.howes.civ@army.mil. Quotes must include a completed SF 1449 and a separate Technical Proposal responding to the evaluation criteria outlined in the FAR 52.212-1 and 52.212-2 Addenda.

title: Desiccant Dehumidifier System Replacement Project Plant Material Center, Tucson, AZ
description: The correct Solicitation Number is 12FPC326Q0049. The USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS) Tucson Plant Materials Center is in need of a replacement Dehumidifier Unit for the walk-in seed cooler. This cooler operates at a stable temperature of 35�F and a relative humidity range of 25�40 percent, conditions supported by both an air�conditioning condenser unit and a dedicated desiccant dehumidifier system. Work includes the acquisition and installation of a desiccant dehumidifier that meets all our requirements, including necessary mounting brackets, air vents, proper insulation, and electrical parts. title: RCTA Proactive Criminal Patrol
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 12, as supplemented with additional information included in the notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number W50S7J26QA006 is being issued as a Request for Quote (RFQ) with OPEN MARKET PRICING. This solicitation document, incorporated provisions, and clauses are those in effect through Revolutionary Far Overhaul Federal Effective July 28, 2026, and the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulations (DFARS) Publication Notice (DPN) dated May 07, 2026. This requirement is a small business set aside under NAICS 611699 with a size standard of $16.5M. The MS Army National Guard and the Regional Counterdrug Training Academy (RCTA) have a requirement for.Instructional Services for Proactive Criminal Patrol Courses in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement. The USPFO-MS intends to issue a firm fixed price contract for the courses listed below: CLIN 0001 � Proactive Criminal Patrol CLIN 0002 � Advanced Criminal Patrol CLIN 0003 � Roadside Interview Techniques POP: Sept 2026 � Sept 2027 Exact starting POP will be determined based on award date. Place and Performance of Services: RCTA � 219 Fuller Road, Meridian, MS 39309 and Camp Shelby, Hattiesburg, MS 39402, and other locations in accordance with performance work statement. Remote classes are not authorized. Basis of Award: The government intends to award a firm fixed price contract to the responsible offeror whose quote conforms to the solicitation and is considered to be the most advantageous to the Government in accordance with RFO Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. Evaluation will be in accordance with RFO Subpart 12.2 and is based on Best Value to the Government in terms of (i) Technical capability of the service offered to meet the Government requirement; (i) Price; (ii) Technical . Technical shall be weighted higher than price. To ensure a timely and equitable evaluation of quotes, offerors must comply with the instructions contained herein. Quotes must be complete, self-sufficient, and respond directly to the requirements of this RFQ. Quotes shall include: (1) Price quoted to include itemized description of what is included. (2) detailed specifications and service/course literature that sufficiently describe the service(s) being offered. (3) Date for the 1st class to be held in the month of September. Note: Quotes submitted without detailed specification will not be considered acceptable and shall be removed from further consideration. Quotes are limited to 8 pages including pricing which shall be itemized and information page. This notice does not obligate the Government to award the contract; it does not restrict the government's ultimate approach; nor does it obligate the Government to pay for any quote/proposal preparation costs. Only firm fixed price offers will be evaluated. Along with the quote, please provide company Name with CAGE Code, TIN, UEI and company POC with contact information (email and telephone number). Prompt payment discount terms (i.e. Net 30). SAM is a mandatory requirement for all DoD Government contracts. You must be registered and have an active status in order to be eligible for the award of a contract. To register online go to http://www.sam.gov/. It is the contractors' responsibility to be familiar with applicable Clauses and Provisions. Clauses and provisions incorporated by reference may be accessed via https://www.acquisition.gov/. Please see attached listings of Clauses and Provisions. Questions shall be submitted no later than 2:00 p.m., August 27, 2026. Answers will be posted NLT 4:30 p.m., September 01, 2026. The deadline for receipt of your quote is established no later than 3:30 P.M. Central Daylight Time (CDT), Wednesday, September 16, 2026. Please email proposals to ned.mccormick.2@us.af.mil and jared.garner@us.af.mil.

title: Rakennusurakointitöiden puitehankinta vuosille 2026 - 2029
description: Rakennusurakointitöiden puitehankinta vuosille 2026 - 2029 Naantalin kaupungin yksiköt (Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia rakennusurakointitöiden toteuttamisesta sopimuskaudelle. Hankinnan kohteena olevat työt toteutetaan joko erikseen minikilpailutettavina toimeksiantoina tai suoraan hankittavina töinä sopimusehtojen mukaisesti. Rakennusurakoita kilpailutetaan lisäksi kohdekohtaisilla urakkakilpailulla. Sopimuskauden arvioitu alkamisajankohta on 1.11.2026. Lisäksi Tilaaja varaa mahdollisuuden kahteen optiovuoteen (1+1). Optiolla tarkoitetaan mahdollisuutta sopimuksen jatkamiseen alkuperäisin ehdoin. Tilaaja päättää optioiden käytöstä erikseen. Hankinta tullaan toteuttamaan puitejärjestelynä. Tilattavien töiden sisältö ja määrä eivät ole ennalta tiedossa eikä Tilaaja sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin sopimuskauden aikana. Pienurakat voivat sisältää rakennus-, maalaus-, matto-, tasoite-, vedeneristys- sekä laatoitus- ja teräsrakennetöitä. Urakat toteutetaan noudattaen rakennusalan yleisiä sopimusehtoja YSE 1998.,

title: Vaajakosken liikuntapuiston tulostaulu
description: Vaajakosken liikuntapuiston tulostaulu Jyväskylän kaupungin liikuntapalvelut pyytää tarjousta yhdestä (1) tulostaulusta/videotaulusta. Taulu sijoitetaan Vaajakosken liikuntapuistoon, joka on pääasiallisesti yleisurheilun, jalkapallon ja amerikkalaisen jalkapallon käytössä. Taulun toimitukseen tulee sisältyä tarvittavat ohjelmistot, ohjauslaitteet, asennus ja käytönopastus. Lisäksi hankintaan sisältyy taulun sähköistys tarjouspyynnössä olevan liitteen mukaisesti. Tulostaulun asennus suoritetaan tilaajan osoittamaan valmiiseen asennuspaikkaan. Asennuspaikan tekniset tiedot on esitetty tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Taulun teline on valmisteilla. Tulostaulun asennusvalmius on alustavan arvion mukaan viikosta 43 alkaen. Mikäli tulostaulun asennus tapahtuu peruskorjauksen ollessa käynnissä, tehdään valitun toimittajan kanssa alistamissopimus suhteessa taulun telineen päätoteuttajaan. Peruskorjauksen arvioitu keskeytyminen talvikauden ajaksi on 13.11. alkaen. Mikäli tulostaulun toimitus ja asennus tapahtuu tämän jälkeen, vastaa taulun toimittaja työmaan turvallisuudesta ja muista velvoitteista.,

title: D-- FRONTIER Internet Services
description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source - Commercial Internet and Telecommunications Services (Frontier) Notice ID:140L1226Q0045 This is a Sole Source Notice posted in accordance with RFO 5.201(b)(1)(i). The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) intends to purchase, on a sole source basis, commercial internet access and related telecommunications services from Frontier Communications of America, Inc. to support operations at specified BLM facilities in California. The requirement covers installation/activation of last mile facilities, handoff to Government premises equipment, static IP configuration as needed, and ongoing monthly service. This acquisition is necessary to maintain continuity of operations and ensure connectivity at these locations where Frontier is the only responsible source with existing serviceable plant. This determination is based on program market research and site level technical reviews documenting the lack of alternative carriers with facilities in the immediate vicinity. This purchase will be conducted under the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul commercial procedures at RFO 12.102. This action is justified under RFO 6.103-1(b), Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. A firm fixed-price award is anticipated. The associated NAICS code for this requirement is 517111 (Wired Telecommunications Carriers). The vendor's SAM information is: Frontier Communications of America, Inc., UEI DLHBZQ65RZA7, CAGE 341B8 (Active registration; no exclusions). The applicable PSC is DG11 (IT and Telecom - Network: Satellite Communications and Telecom Access Services). The attached sole source justification has been made available for review. No solicitation documents exist. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotes or offers. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed action lies solely within the discretion of the Government. Firms believing they have the capability to provide this requirement must submit written information showing clear and convincing evidence that they can deliver equivalent services to all listed BLM facilities using existing infrastructure without new construction or schedule risk, and that they can meet the Government's technical, performance, and continuity needs.

This access features analysis and data on market fundamentals, policies, and changing customer demands and is critical to NETL�s Strategic Systems Analysis and Engineering mission. This access also provides insight on technology, cost and pricing trends impacting global renewables development and will help inform NETL�s strategic decision-making on its research and technology programs. This is considered a sole source to S&P Global Energy because to the best of NETL�s knowledge, S&P Global Energy is the sole provider of this Regional Integrated/North America and Clean Energy Technology service. title: D--SPECTRUM SERVICES
description: Notice of Intent to Sole Source Commercial Internet and Telecommunications Services (Spectrum) Notice ID: 140L1226Q0046 This is a Sole Source Notice posted in accordance with RFO 5.201(b)(1)(i). The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) intends to purchase, on a sole source basis, commercial internet access and related telecommunications services from Charter Communications Operating LLC (Spectrum) to support operations at specified BLM facilities in California. The requirement covers installation/activation of last mile facilities, handoff to Government premises equipment, static IP configuration as needed, and ongoing monthly service. This acquisition is necessary to maintain continuity of operations and ensure connectivity at these locations where Spectrum is the only responsible source with existing serviceable plant. This purchase will be conducted under the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul commercial procedures at RFO 12.102. The applicable PSC is DG11 (IT and Telecom Network: Satellite Communications and Telecom Access Services). The attached sole source justification has been made available for review. No solicitation documents exist. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotes or offers. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed action lies solely within the discretion of the Government. Firms believing they have the capability to provide this requirement must submit written information showing clear and convincing evidence that they can deliver equivalent services to all listed BLM facilities using existing infrastructure without new construction or schedule risk, and that they can meet the Government's technical, performance, and continuity needs.

title: Italy – Stationery – FORNITURA DI CANCELLERIA E CARTA MEDIANTE CATALOGO ELETTRONICO, COMPRENSIVA DI TRASPORTO (CONSEGNA) E RELATIVI SERVIZI ACCESSORI
description: Accordo Quadro con un unico operatore ai sensi dell’art. 59 comma 3 del Codice avente ad oggetto la fornitura, mediante catalogo elettronico, di cancelleria e carta comprensiva di trasporto (consegna) e relativi servizi accessori per Rai S.p.A. e relative consociate, quali Rai Com S.p.A. Rai Cinema S.p.A. e Rai Pubblicità S.p.A.. Per consentire il confronto competitivo è stato individuato un paniere di prodotti in funzione dei consumi storici e rappresentativo delle principali categorie di acquisto della Stazione appaltante, articolato nelle due categorie merceologiche della cancelleria e della carta per fotocopie e stampa. È altresì previsto l’approvvigionamento di articoli non ricompresi nel paniere, ma appartenenti alle medesime categorie merceologiche oggetto dell’affidamento ed, a tal fine, l’aggiudicatario dovrà rendere disponibile il proprio catalogo elettronico di prodotti che, allegato all’Accordo Quadro, costituirà il riferimento contrattuale per l’acquisizione dei prodotti non inclusi nel paniere e potrà essere aggiornato nel corso dell'esecuzione mediante inserimento di nuovi articoli o sostituzione di prodotti non più commercializzati. Tale impostazione consente di effettuare il confronto concorrenziale sulla componente maggiormente rappresentativa dei consumi aziendali, garantendo al contempo la necessaria flessibilità per l’acquisizione di ulteriori articoli appartenenti alle medesime categorie merceologiche, non preventivamente stimabili in termini quantitativi, mantenendo condizioni economiche coerenti con quelle risultanti dalla procedura di gara. Il Capitolato Tecnico, cui si rinvia, prevede altresì i seguenti servizi accessori: - messa a disposizione di una piattaforma e-procurement in grado di gestire un numero illimitato di profili di navigazione e che consenta le funzionalità di cui al Capitolato tecnico, tra cui, a mero titolo esemplificativo, la consultazione di un catalogo elettronico e l’estrazione di report sintetici di dettaglio; - attivazione di un servizio di call center dalle ore 09.00 alle ore 17:00 di tutti i giorni lavorativi; - reportistica trimestrale di dati aggregati per singola categoria merceologica; - imballaggio, trasporto e recapito al piano (cd. punto di consegna) presso le sedi indicate nel Capitolato Tecnico e dislocate sull’intero territorio nazionale. In particolare, è richiesto che la fornitura sia gestita mediante ordinativi su catalogo elettronico globale dedicato, con caratteristiche e funzionalità (consultazione, ricerca articolo, invio ordine ecc.) corrispondenti a quanto descritto nel Capitolato Tecnico e relative appendici. Pertanto, condizione necessaria per il corretto espletamento della fornitura è che ciascun concorrente offra la possibilità di disporre di un proprio "portale internet” ove vengano riportati, resi visibili e disponibili per l’acquisto mediante "carrello elettronico" i prodotti oggetto del proprio listino di vendita, come descritto nel Capitolato tecnico. La fornitura è infine comprensiva di ogni onere relativo a trasporto, imballaggio e protezione fino alla consegna. La fornitura è comprensiva delle schede tecniche e di sicurezza dei materiali forniti e delle dichiarazioni di conformità rilasciate dal produttore a norma di legge. Per la dettagliata descrizione delle caratteristiche tecniche e funzionali della fornitura nonché delle modalità di esecuzione della stessa si rimanda alla documentazione tecnica allegata alle citate RdA. Con riferimento alla fornitura di carta, assumono rilievo i Criteri Ambientali minimi per la fornitura di carta in risme (c.d. CAM) di cui al Decreto del Ministero dell’ambiente e della tutela del territorio e del mare del 4 aprile 2013.

title: Italy – General management consultancy services – Servizi di consulenza strategica in favore di RAI S.p.A.
description: l servizio è articolato nei seguenti ambiti principali, con riferimento ai quali l’aggiudicatario sarà chiamato a svolgere le attività descritte nel Capitolato Tecnico per il soddisfacimento dei diversi fabbisogni: a) servizi di consulenza per lo sviluppo di piani industriali, comprensivi delle relative analisi strategiche ed economico-finanziarie; b) servizi di consulenza strategica per singoli progetti aziendali, incluse iniziative di sviluppo industriale, razionalizzazione organizzativa, sviluppo tecnologico, valutazione di sinergie industriali e operazioni di riassetto societario o di Gruppo; c) servizi di program/project management a supporto dell’implementazione di piani industriali e di progetti strategici comprensivi delle attività di monitoraggio, gestione del cambiamento organizzativo, misurazione delle performance, reporting direzionale e supporto al conseguimento degli obiettivi progettuali. Le attività potranno comportare la predisposizione di studi, analisi, business plan, proiezioni economico-finanziarie, documenti programmatici, piani di lavoro, report direzionali, cruscotti di monitoraggio e ogni altra documentazione funzionale al perseguimento degli obiettivi definiti da RAI. L’aggiudicatario dovrà supportare RAI in relazione ai fabbisogni di volta in volta espressi nell’ambito dei servizi oggetto dell'Accordo Quadro, garantendo per tutta la durata contrattuale la disponibilità di professionalità idonee a presidiare l'intera gamma delle attività previste dalla documentazione di gara nonché la capacità organizzativa necessaria ad assicurare, ove richiesto, la contemporanea esecuzione di più interventi progettuali. La regolamentazione progettuale ed economica delle prestazioni è basata sul modello settimane/Full Time Equivalent (FTE). Il corrispettivo di ciascun intervento sarà determinato sulla base dell'effort progettuale stimato e della composizione del team richiesta, definita mediante il mix delle figure professionali previste dal Capitolato Tecnico e calibrata in funzione della complessità, della durata, degli obiettivi e degli output dell'incarico. Le attività saranno attivate mediante specifici contratti attuativi, nell’ambito dei quali saranno individuati il dimensionamento dell’intervento, il team di riferimento e le relative modalità di esecuzione. Le risorse impiegate nell’esecuzione dei servizi resteranno in ogni momento alle esclusive dipendenze dell’aggiudicatario e opereranno sotto la sua direzione, coordinamento e responsabilità organizzativa. L’aggiudicatario conserverà in via esclusiva ogni potere datoriale, gerarchico, organizzativo, disciplinare e gestionale nei confronti delle risorse impiegate. RAI definirà esclusivamente il fabbisogno, gli obiettivi dell’intervento, gli output attesi, le relative tempistiche, le modalità di interazione con le proprie strutture, le eventuali sedi di svolgimento delle attività e i criteri di verifica delle prestazioni rese. Resteranno di esclusiva competenza dell’aggiudicatario l’organizzazione operativa delle attività, l’individuazione delle risorse da impiegare e la gestione del team di progetto, fermo restando il rispetto dei requisiti professionali previsti dalla documentazione di gara e di quanto eventualmente offerto in sede di gara. Per la dettagliata descrizione delle caratteristiche tecniche e funzionali del servizio nonché delle modalità di esecuzione dello stesso si rimanda alla documentazione tecnica di gara. Ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma 1 lettera a) del Codice, Rai S.p.A. si riserva: - la facoltà, qualora l’importo contrattuale non dovesse essere esaurito alla scadenza del termine di durata contrattuale di estendere la durata del relativo contratto per il tempo necessario all’utilizzo dell’intero importo contrattuale; - la facoltà di richiedere all’appaltatore, nel corso della durata del contratto, in caso di esigenze sopravvenute che determino un incremento o decremento del fabbisogno di servizi, un aumento o diminuzione delle prestazioni, a parità di condizioni, per un importo fino ad euro 360.000,00, anche ai sensi dell’art. 120 comma 9 del Codice; in tal evenienza l'appaltatore non può fare valere il diritto alla risoluzione del contratto. In casi eccezionali, al verificarsi delle condizioni indicate all’art. 120 comma 11 del Codice, la durata del contratto (se del caso come estesa ai sensi dell’art. 120, comma 1, lett. a) del Codice come sopra previsto), ancora in corso di esecuzione, potrà essere prorogata per il tempo strettamente necessario alla conclusione della procedura di individuazione del nuovo contraente. In tal caso l’appaltatore sarà tenuto all’esecuzione delle prestazioni oggetto del contratto agli stessi prezzi, patti e condizioni previsti nello stesso.

Das wirtschaftliche Risiko der Betriebsführung trägt die/der Aufragnehmende. Der Dienstleistungsvertrag ist auf 4 Jahre und 6 Monate befristet sein. Er soll am 01.02.2027 beginnen und am 31.07.2031 enden. Für den Auftraggeber besteht die Option das Vertragsverhältnis einmalig um ein Jahr bis längstens zum 31.07.2032 zu verlängern.

Es handelt sich um einen großen, aus mehreren Bauteilen zusammengesetzten Baukörper mit zentraler Empfangshalle, an die ein zweigeschossiger Ostflügel und ein ebenfalls zweigeschossiger Westflügel angrenzen, in denen ehemalige Diensträume, Wartesäle verschiedener Klassen, Räume für Post, Zoll und Polizei sowie Wohnräume des Vorstehers untergebracht waren. Die Bereiche der ehemaligen Wartesäle und des Westflügels sind unterkellert. Das Gebäude wurde in dunkelrotem Backstein errichtet, die einzelnen Bauteile sind mit Walm- und Satteldächern versehen. Die Fassaden sind durch Lisenen und Gesimse zurückhaltend gegliedert. Besonders hervorgehoben ist die Giebelseite mit dem Haupteingang durch Verwendung dekorativer Bachsteinverbände sowie ein lebhaft gestaltetes Giebelgesims. Im Zuge dieses Bauvorhabens wird das Bahnhofsgebäude grundlegend saniert, umgebaut und erweitert.

title: Germany – Construction work for houses – TNW: Investorenwettbewerb Umgestaltung Schillerplatzareal Iserlohn
description: Das Schillerplatzareal in Iserlohn befindet sich im Zentrum der Stadt und stellt eine der wichtigsten Entwicklungsflächen im Rahmen der städtischen Erneuerungsstrategie dar. Ziel ist es, die städtebauliche Qualität und die Nutzungsvielfalt im Innenstadtbereich nachhaltig zu verbessern und die Funktion des Schillerplatzes als urbanes Zentrum zu stärken. Das Areal umfasst rd. 12.000 m² und liegt in direkter Nachbarschaft zu Rathaus, Stadt-Sparkasse, Stadthotel und Fußgängerzone, welche zugleich die südliche Grenze des Areals bildet. Dadurch ist eine direkte Anbindung an die wichtigsten innerstädtischen Verkehrs- und Aufenthaltsbereiche gewährleistet. Im Vorfeld der geplanten Entwicklung wurden bereits wesentliche vorbereitende Maßnahmen auf der Projektfläche durchgeführt, darunter der Abriss der ehemaligen Karstadt-Immobilie und der zugehörigen Tiefgarage sowie die Erkundung und Sicherung unterirdischer Hohlräume (Verkarstung und Erz-Bergbau). Unmittelbar an das Projektareal angrenzend (nördliche Seite des Theodor-Heuss-Rings) befindet sich derzeit das Rathaus I. Mit dem Abbruch des Rathaus I. wird voraussichtlich noch in 2026 begonnen. Zielvorgaben, Umfang und terminliche Umsetzung für einen möglichen Neubau an diesem Ort sind noch nicht bekannt. Das Schillerplatzareal und sein Umfeld bieten somit die Voraussetzungen für eine umfassende städtebauliche Entwicklung und das Projektareal stellt einen zentralen Baustein für die zukünftige Gestaltung und Nutzung der Iserlohner Innenstadt dar.

title: Germany – Metalworking – Stadt Löhne, Umbau Bahnhof zum 3. Ort - Metallbauarbeiten-Fassaden-Außen-Innentüren
description: Die Stadt Löhne beabsichtigt den Umbau des Empfangsgebäudes des Bahnhofs Löhne zu einem "Dritten Ort". Das in Teilen Denkmal geschützte Empfangsgebäude des Bahnhofs Löhne wurde in den Jahren 1913 ff. errichtet. Es handelt sich um einen großen, aus mehreren Bauteilen zusammengesetzten Baukörper mit zentraler Empfangshalle, an die ein zweigeschossiger Ostflügel und ein ebenfalls zweigeschossiger Westflügel angrenzen, in denen ehemalige Diensträume, Wartesäle verschiedener Klassen, Räume für Post, Zoll und Polizei sowie Wohnräume des Vorstehers untergebracht waren. Die Bereiche der ehemaligen Wartesäle und des Westflügels sind unterkellert. Das Gebäude wurde in dunkelrotem Backstein errichtet, die einzelnen Bauteile sind mit Walm- und Satteldächern versehen. Die Fassaden sind durch Lisenen und Gesimse zurückhaltend gegliedert. Besonders hervorgehoben ist die Giebelseite mit dem Haupteingang durch Verwendung dekorativer Bachsteinverbände sowie ein lebhaft gestaltetes Giebelgesims. Im Zuge dieses Bauvorhabens wird das Bahnhofsgebäude grundlegend saniert, umgebaut und erweitert.

title: Germany – Resurfacing works – Landesstraßen im Landkreis Nordhausen; Beseitigung Fahrbahnschäden, Abschnittsweise Deckenerneuerung - Rahmenvereinbarung 2026/2027
description: Es handelt sich um eine Rahmenvereinbarung gemäß § 4a EU VOB/A. Das bedeutet, dass die Bedingungen für Einzelaufträge innerhalb der Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung festgelegt werden sollen. Dies betrifft insbesondere die in Aussicht genommenen Preise. Die Rahmenvereinbarung wird mit einem Unternehmen geschlossen. Das in Aussicht genommene Auftragsvolumen wurde so genau wie möglich ermittelt, wird aber nicht abschließend festgelegt. Es besteht kein Anspruch auf eine komplette Leistungsausführung lt. Leistungsverzeichnis. Der Leistungsumfang kann sich bei einzelnen Positionen erheblich erhöhen, aber auch ganz entfallen. Es ist vorgesehen innerhalb der Grundlaufzeit (09.11.2026 – 31.12.2027) bis zu fünf Einzelmaßnahmen in Form räumlich abgegrenzter, zusammenhängender Streckenabschnitte auszuführen. Für die Kalkulation kann von mindestens 3 Einzelaufträgen ausgegangen werden. Diese sind bereits konkret bekannt und betreffen folgende Streckenabschnitte: L 3080 Nordhausen - Bielen vNK 4530 014 nNK 4531 049Y L 3080 Bielen - AS Heringen vNK 4530 014 nNK 4531 049Y L 3080 AS Heringen - Urbach VnK 4531 049X nNK 4531 012 Die im Leistungsverzeichnis angegebenen Mengen beruhen auf Erfahrungswerten vergleichbarer Maßnahmen und stellen unverbindliche Schätzmengen dar. Sie dienen ausschließlich der Kalkulation der Angebote. Bei einer Vertragsverlängerung (gem. Punkt 5.1.1 Optionen) kann davon ausgegangen werden, dass mindestens 1 und maximal 3 Einzelmaßnahmen je Verlängerungsjahr beauftragt werden. Die Sanierung erfolgt im Wesentlichen durch die Herstellung neuer bituminöser Fahrbahnaufbauten. Abhängig vom jeweiligen Schadensbild reicht der Sanierungsumfang von der Erneuerung einzelner Asphaltschichten bis zur vollständigen Erneuerung des Oberbaus einschließlich Trag-, Binder- und Deckschicht. Die erforderlichen Aufbruch- bzw. Frästiefen können zwischen 4 cm und ca. 25 cm liegen und werden im Einzelfall durch den Auftraggeber festgelegt.

description: Åre kommun avser genom denna upphandling att teckna avtal om insamling, transport, omlastning och fjärrtransport av kommunalt avfall inom Åre kommun (”Uppdraget”). Uppdraget omfattar bland annat: - Insamling av restavfall och matavfall från hushåll och verksamheter. - Tömning av avfallskärl, containrar, komprimatorer samt mark- och underjordsbehållare. - Budade extratömningar och akuta extratömningar. - Tömning av uppsamlingsplats inklusive betalsäckstationer och CUS. - Transport av avfall från abonnent till omlastningsstation. - Tillhandahållande av omlastningsstation samt vägning och omlastning av insamlat avfall. - Fjärrtransport av avfall till behandlingsanläggning. - Utsättning, utbyte, återtag, märkning, registrering och enklare reparation av avfallskärl. Uppdraget är inte föremål för anbudsräkning i egen regi. title: Secure Packaged Microelectronic Components, Printed Circuit Boards, and Supporting Technologies
description: Information Requested: The U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command Aviation and Missile Center (DEVCOM AvMC), Redstone Arsenal, AL is conducting market research to identify domestic products, suppliers, designers and manufacturers of advanced protection architectures, systems, components, and other technologies for packaged microelectronics intended for deployment into current and future military systems of interest to the Department of Defense (DoD). This RFI is seeking information from suitable vendors/vendor teams related to the following Technology Areas: 1. Board-level Security: Capabilities spanning microelectronic components and portable soft IP integrated with commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) devices across modular open systems architectures (MOSA) form factor systems (e.g., 3U/6U OpenVPX/SOSA, 3U/6U SpaceVPX, VNX, and smaller). 2. Package Security: Specialized microelectronics packaging configurations or designs for multi-chip modules (MCMs) or systems-in-package (SIPs) which utilize COTS or bespoke security components that are intended to provide additional security to underlying components. 3. Enhanced Secure Boot: Portable soft IP that can be used in conjunction with COTS microelectronic components to provide additional security for enhanced secure boot applications. 4. Secure Components: Purpose-designed microelectronic components (chiplets, ASICs, etc.) that are intended to provide enhanced trust/security for co-packaged microelectronic components. 5. Multi-chip Packaging: Advanced microelectronics packaging techniques that inherently provide additional component security or could be easily adapted to provide additional microelectronic component security. 6. Emerging Technologies: Novel techniques, materials, and processes that are compatible with modern microelectronic manufacturing/packaging methods that can provide additional security to packaged microelectronic components. 7. Other: Technologies, methods, and processes not mentioned above that are compatible with modern microelectronics design, manufacturing, and packaging techniques and able to provide enhanced security to packaged microelectronic components. For additional details refer to the Attachment, R2.0_SS_RFI_SUBMISSION_v1.2.

description: Sources Sought Notice U.S. Embassy Mexico�International Narcotics & Law Enforcement Affairs (INL Mexico) Equipment for Mexican Vetted Units INL Mexico seeks to provide tactical, ballistics, and personal protective equipment (PPE) to INL-supported vetted units, as well as federal and state task forces that collaborate with U.S. law enforcement agencies to disrupt cartel-related illicit activities. These units play a critical role in seizing fentanyl and other illicit drugs and goods, apprehending fugitives and individuals affiliated with cartels, and investigating cases linked to transnational criminal organizations (TCOs). This Sources Sought Notice is part of the U.S. Government's market research efforts to identify capable small business vendors that are qualified and capable to deliver equipment for the U.S. Embassy Mexico City that will be donated to vetted units of Mexican agencies. The information gathered will help inform future procurement strategies and requirements including selection of applicable socioeconomic programs and small business set-asides for future procurement. This Sources Sought is issued solely for information and planning purposes - it does not constitute a Request for Quotation (RFQ), Invitation for Bid (IFB), or Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFQ, IFB or RFP in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service. Further, the U.S. Government is not seeking quotes, bids or proposals at this time and will not accept unsolicited proposals in response to this notice. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. Submittals will not be returned to the responder. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future RFQ, IFB, or RFP, if any is issued. This equipment donation consists of twenty-seven individual types of equipment organized into three groups: Group 1: Personal Protective Equipment 6 Equpiment Line Items Planned NAICS Code: 423990 Group 2: Tactical Equipment 16 Equipment Line Items Planned NAICS Code: 423850 Group 3: Ballistics Equipment 5 Equipment Line Items Planned NAICS Code: 315990 All equipment must be provided through manufacturer approved distribution channels and must be new. The government contemplates issuance of an RFQ that permits firms to quote on one, two, or all three equipment groups. However, quoting firms must be able to provide all equipment types within each group. The contractor must be able to deliver the equipment to a receiving location in Brownsville, Texas, and provide personnel to participate in a joint inspection and inventory with personnel from the Department of State. title: ISBEE Set-Aside: Exercise Equipment for the Great Plains Area IHS Youth Regional Treatment Center
description: Combined Synopsis � Solicitation 75H70626Q00233 The Aberdeen Area Indian Health Service (IHS) is soliciting quotations for the purchase of commercial-grade fitness equipment, including delivery, assembly, installation, operational verification, orientation, and warranty documentation, for the Great Plains Area Youth Regional Treatment Center (YRTC), 12451 SD-1806, Mobridge, South Dakota 57601. The acquisition is issued as RFQ 75H70626Q00233 and is a 100% Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE) set-aside under the Buy Indian Act. The applicable NAICS code is 423910. Requirement The contractor will furnish and install six pieces of commercial fitness equipment, or technically acceptable equal products: | 1 | Inflight Fitness Multi Bicep/Tricep, 150-lb stack, CT-MBTS-150 | 2 | Inflight Fitness Multi Inner/Outer Thigh, 150-lb stack, CT-MIOS-150 | 3 | Inflight Fitness Multi Seated Leg Extension/Leg Curl, 250-lb stack, CT-MSECS-250 | 4 | Inflight Fitness Multi Press, 250-lb stack, CT-MPSS-250 | 5 | Inflight Fitness Multi Leg Press, 250-lb stack, CT-MLPS-250 | 6 | Muscle D Commercial Stair Climber with LED Console, CC-SC-LS-B Shipping is identified separately as Item 7. The identified brands/models establish the type of equipment contemplated rather than an absolute brand restriction. Equal products may be offered if they satisfy the solicitation's salient functional and performance characteristics. Reference-product dimensions and weights are principally for delivery and installation planning and are not exact design restrictions unless necessary to fit the Government-designated installation area. Quantities are firm requirements. Delivery and Performance Performance begins upon award. The contractor must complete delivery, installation, operational verification, orientation, and submission of warranty documentation within 30�60 calendar days after award, unless the award establishes another completion date or the Contracting Officer subsequently changes it in writing. Contractors are required to promptly advise the Contracting Officer of anticipated commercial supply-chain delays. Pricing is to be FOB Destination and must include packaging, handling, shipping, and delivery. Unit prices are described as all-inclusive of costs associated with performance. Competition and Eligibility Competition is limited to concerns that qualify as both an Indian Economic Enterprise and a small business concern. Firms that do not meet both requirements will not be considered. Offerors must submit the required Indian Economic Enterprise Representation Form and represent that they meet the IEE definition and will continue to meet it throughout contract performance. Offerors must also have an active SAM.gov registration and current UEI before award and certify that they are an authorized reseller of the products proposed and that applicable manufacturer warranties will be fully honored. Evaluation and Award The procurement uses a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) approach. Award will be made to the responsible offeror submitting the lowest evaluated price whose quotation is technically acceptable and whose past performance is acceptable, if evaluated. The Government intends to evaluate quotations without discussions but reserves the right to conduct discussions. Technical evaluation is Acceptable/Unacceptable. To receive an Acceptable rating, the quotation must demonstrate compliance with all material solicitation requirements, including specifications, salient characteristics, delivery requirements, and mandatory technical requirements. An Unacceptable quotation is ineligible for award. Price will be evaluated for total evaluated price and may also be assessed for reasonableness and completeness. Past performance may be rated Acceptable, Unacceptable, or Neutral. CPARS will be the primary source; when CPARS information is unavailable, an offeror may use the solicitation's Past Performance Questionnaire. Offerors may provide up to three references for recent and relevant contracts/orders performed within the preceding five years involving work similar in scope, size, and complexity. A firm without relevant past performance is not evaluated favorably or unfavorably. Submission Requirements and Key Dates The solicitation was issued September 2, 2026. Questions must be emailed to the Contract Specialist by 4:00 p.m. CDT on September 9, 2026. Written quotations are due 5:00 p.m. CDT on September 16, 2026. Email submissions are permitted; facsimile submissions are not, and no original hard copy is required. The solicitation identifies three attachments that form part of the procurement package: 1. SOW_YRTC_Fitness_Equipment 2. Indian Firm Representation Form-26Q00233 3. Past Performance Questionnaire Contract Administration Invoices must be submitted electronically through the Department of Treasury's Invoice Processing Platform (IPP) in accordance with HHSAR 352.232-71, unless the Contracting Officer authorizes an alternate method in writing. Required invoice information includes the contractor name, invoice number/date, complete award number, description/quantity/pricing, shipping and payment terms, UEI/TIN, and contractor contact information. In summary: this is a Buy Indian, 100% ISBEE-set-aside commercial-item procurement for six installed pieces of fitness equipment at the Mobridge YRTC. The Government is seeking a compliant, technically acceptable solution�including delivery and installation�at the lowest evaluated price, with contractor eligibility, technical compliance, delivery capability, authorized-reseller/warranty status, and past performance forming the principal award considerations.
